# ChemLife Innovations

> ChemLife Innovations is an animal nutrition company in Bengaluru, India, that makes nature-derived functional feed additives for poultry, dairy and livestock. Its products are made with ANBioT, ChemLife's bio-transformation technology rooted in Ayurveda.

The range covers mycotoxin binders, mold inhibitors and feed hygiene, gut and liver support, layer nutrition, rumen-protected methionine and choline, rumen buffers and chelated trace minerals. Product questions and distribution enquiries go to the contact details at the end of this file.

## Pages

- [Home](https://chemlifeinnovations.com): Nature-derived functional feed additives for poultry, dairy and livestock, made with ANBioT.
- [About](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/about): How ChemLife bridges Ayurvedic plant wisdom and modern biotechnology; founders, mission and values.
- [Products](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products): All feed additives with descriptions, key features, inclusion rates and pack sizes.
- [Research & Technology](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/research): ANBioT bio-transformation, green trace-mineral chelation and bioavailability research.
- [Insights](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/insights): Articles, videos and podcasts on feed hygiene, mycotoxins, mold control and animal nutrition.
- [Careers](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/careers): 6-month paid industrial internships in Bengaluru in research, animal nutrition, and operations, marketing and HR.
- [Contact](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/contact): Product and distribution-partnership enquiries.
- [AI nutrition experts](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/chat): Chat assistants for feed and nutrition questions: [Dr. Kukku](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/chat/kukku) for poultry and [Dr. Mikku](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/chat/mikku) for dairy and ruminants.

## Products: Poultry and other monogastric animals

- [MaxDmold](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=MaxDmold): MaxDmold is a bioactive mold inhibition solution formulated with copper chelates and natural phenolic compounds. Inclusion rate: 25 g/MT of feed or feed ingredients (or as recommended by the Nutritionist).
- [MaxDmold Plus](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=MaxDmold%20Plus): MaxDmold Plus is an advanced feed hygiene solution engineered for simultaneous control of molds and pathogenic bacteria. Inclusion rate: 250 g/MT of feed or feed ingredients (or as recommended by the Nutritionist).
- [GroGenie (12% & 60%)](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=GroGenie): GroGenie is a non-antibiotic gut performance solution developed to improve intestinal microbial balance and nutrient utilization. Inclusion rate: GroGenie 12%: 500 g/MT of feed (up to 1 kg/MT under challenge conditions); GroGenie 60%: 100 g/MT of feed (up to 500 g/MT under challenge conditions).
- [LivproGenie](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=LivproGenie): LivproGenie is a phyto-nutritional liver support solution designed to optimize hepatic metabolism and detoxification in poultry. Inclusion rate: Broilers: 10 ml/ 100 birds: 2-3 weeks; Broilers: 20 ml/100 birds: 4th week onward; Breeders & layers: 20 ml/100 birds; Or as recommended by the Nutritionist.
- [EggGenie](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=EggGenie): EggGenie is a precision layer nutrition solution combining bioavailable trace minerals, essential amino acids, and botanical actives. Inclusion rate: Standard Inclusion: 500g/MT feed; Stress Conditions: 750g/MT feed; Or as recommended by the Nutritionist.
- [GutproGenie](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=GutproGenie): GutproGenie is a targeted poultry gut health solution that integrates organic acids, phytogenic compounds, and amino acid complexes. Inclusion rate: Chicks: 2-4 ml / L of water; Broilers: 1-2 ml/L of water; Breeders & Layers: 1-2 ml/L of water; Or as recommended by the Nutritionist.
- [FeedGenie Forte](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=FeedGenie%20Forte): FeedGenie Forte is an advanced aflatoxin management solution developed for poultry feeds. Inclusion rate: 1-2kg /MT.
- [FeedGenie Prime](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=FeedGenie%20Prime): FeedGenie Prime is a holistic mycotoxin management system developed for poultry feeds. Inclusion rate: 1-2 kg/MT of feed (or as recommended by the Nutritionist).

## Products: Dairy cattle, buffalo and other ruminants

- [SynDmold](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=SynDmold): SynDmold is an advanced feed hygiene additive for dairy cattle feeds that combines bioactive mineral complexes with a proprietary natural phytoactive matrix to control bacteria and molds. Inclusion rate: 50 g/MT of feed or feed ingredients (or as recommended by the Nutritionist).
- [MethioWiz](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=MethioWiz): MethioWiz is a rumen-protected methionine supplement developed to maximize post-ruminal methionine availability in dairy cattle. Inclusion rate: Transition Dairy Animals: 20 g/animal/day; Early lactation Dairy Animals: 15-25 g/cow/day; Mid-late lactation Dairy Animals: 10-15 g/cow/day; Small Ruminants: 5-10 g/animal/day; For Dairy Feed: 0.5-2 kg/MT; Or as per the recommendation of a Nutritionist.
- [MBioWiz Plus](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=MBioWiz%20Plus): MBioWiz Plus is a multi-component rumen optimization solution that combines active yeast, enzyme complexes, and phytogenic actives. Inclusion rate: 1 kg/MT of feed (or as recommended by the Nutritionist).
- [MBioWiz TS](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=MBioWiz%20TS): MBioWiz TS is a thermostable rumen optimization technology designed for pelleted and processed dairy feeds. Inclusion rate: 1 kg/MT of feed (or as recommended by the Nutritionist).
- [CholiWiz](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=CholiWiz): CholiWiz is a rumen-protected choline supplement formulated to support liver function during transition and early lactation. Inclusion rate: Dairy Cattle & Buffalo: 25 g/head/day; High-yield dairy cows & Buffaloes in transition: 25 - 50 g/head/day; Feed inclusion: Dairy Cow: 0.75 - 2 kg/MT of Dairy Feed; Goat/Sheep: 2 - 5 g per animal per day; Or as per the recommendation of a Nutritionist.
- [RumiWiz](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=RumiWiz): RumiWiz is a scientifically formulated rumen buffering solution that delivers immediate and sustained pH stabilization. Inclusion rate: 1 kg/MT As recommended by the Nutritionist.
- [AflaMlock](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=AflaMlock): AflaMlock is an advanced mycotoxin management solution for dairy cattle, designed to protect against aflatoxin contamination while supporting feed hygiene and nutrient integrity. Inclusion rate: 1kg /MT.

## Products: Feed hygiene and value addition (all species)

- [MaxDmold Spray](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=MaxDmold%20Spray): MaxDmold Spray is an advanced liquid feed hygiene solution designed for silos and bulk feed storage. Inclusion rate: Spray 250 g of MaxDMold spray diluted with 250 mL water per metric ton of feed or feed ingredients (or as recommended by the Nutritionist).
- [MinBioZen](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=MinBioZen): MinBioZen is a hydroxy amino acid chelated trace mineral technology engineered to maximize mineral bioavailability. Inclusion rate: As recommended by the Nutritionist.
- [DDGS-Dtox](https://chemlifeinnovations.com/products?expand=DDGS-Dtox): DDGS-Dtox is a cutting-edge, dual-acting detoxification strategy specifically designed to target and deactivate aflatoxins and destroy aflatoxin-producing molds. Inclusion rate: Compatible with standard DDGS processing systems (or as recommended by the Nutritionist).
